roti.name: Roti
steps: Knead 45 g atta per roti with water into a soft dough and rest 10 minutes.
Roll thin and cook on a hot tawa until brown spots appear.
Puff briefly over the flame.

paratha.name: Paratha
steps: Knead the dough and rest it, roll, brush with oil and fold.
Roll again and cook on a tawa, adding oil, until golden on both sides.

rice.name: Plain rice
rice.serve: 1 plate (70 g raw, about 200 g cooked)
steps: Wash the rice until the water runs clear.
Boil with twice its volume of water, cover and cook on low for 12 to 15 minutes.

khichdi.name: Khichdi
steps: Wash rice and masoor together.
Fry sliced onion in oil, add spices, then rice and daal with 3 cups of water.
Cook covered for 20 to 25 minutes until soft.

pulao.name: Vegetable pulao
steps: Fry sliced onion in oil until golden, add tomato and spices.
Add soaked rice and 1.5 times water, cook covered on low for 15 minutes.

bread.name: Bread
steps: Eat as it is, or toast it.

oats.name: Oats with milk
steps: Pour hot or cold milk over the oats.
Microwave for 2 minutes or leave overnight in the fridge.

daal_masoor.name: Daal masoor
daal_masoor.serve: 1 bowl (60 g raw, about 200 g cooked)
steps: Boil washed masoor with turmeric and salt for 15 to 20 minutes until soft.
Fry onion, tomato and spices in oil (tarka) and pour over the daal.

daal_chana.name: Daal chana
daal_chana.serve: 1 bowl (60 g raw, about 200 g cooked)
steps: Soak the daal 30 minutes, then boil for 35 to 40 minutes until soft.
Add a tarka of fried onion, tomato and spices.

daal_mash.name: Daal mash
daal_mash.serve: 1 bowl (55 g raw, about 200 g cooked)
steps: Boil washed mash daal for 30 minutes until soft.
Fry onion with ginger-garlic and spices, add to the daal and simmer 5 minutes.

lobia.name: Lobia
lobia.serve: 1 bowl (60 g raw, about 200 g cooked)
steps: Soak lobia overnight.
Boil until soft, about 30 minutes.
Cook with fried onion, tomato and spices for 10 minutes.

chana_masala.name: Chana masala
chana_masala.serve: 1 bowl (60 g raw, about 200 g cooked)
steps: Soak chana overnight and boil 40 minutes until soft.
Fry onion, tomato and spices in oil, add chana and simmer 10 minutes.

soya.name: Soya chunks curry
steps: Soak soya chunks in hot water for 10 minutes and squeeze out the water.
Fry onion, tomato and spices, add the chunks and cook 10 minutes.

egg_boiled.name: Boiled egg
steps: Place the egg in boiling water and cook for 10 minutes.
Cool in cold water and peel.

omelette.name: Omelette
steps: Beat the eggs with chopped onion, tomato and a pinch of salt.
Cook in a little oil on a pan until set on both sides.

chicken_salan.name: Chicken curry
steps: Fry onion in oil until golden, add ginger-garlic and spices.
Add tomato and chicken, cook covered on low for 25 to 30 minutes until tender.

chicken_breast.name: Pan-cooked chicken breast
steps: Marinate with salt, pepper and spices for 15 minutes.
Cook in a pan with a little oil, 6 to 7 minutes each side.

beef_curry.name: Beef curry
steps: Fry onion, ginger-garlic and spices in oil, add beef.
Pressure cook for 25 to 30 minutes, then simmer to thicken the gravy.

keema.name: Keema
steps: Fry onion and ginger-garlic in oil, add the mince and spices.
Add tomato and cook 20 to 25 minutes, stirring.

fish_fry.name: Fried fish
steps: Marinate the fish with spices and salt for 15 minutes.
Coat lightly in flour and shallow fry 4 to 5 minutes each side.

aloo.name: Aloo sabzi
steps: Fry onion, tomato and spices in oil.
Add cubed potato and a little water, cover and cook 15 to 20 minutes.

bhindi.name: Bhindi
steps: Wash and fully dry the okra, then cut into pieces.
Fry onion in oil, add okra and spices, cook uncovered 12 to 15 minutes.

palak.name: Palak
steps: Boil the spinach briefly and blend or chop it.
Fry onion and ginger-garlic, add the spinach and spices, cook 10 minutes.

mixveg.name: Mixed vegetables
steps: Fry onion, tomato and spices in oil.
Add chopped vegetables and a little water, cook covered for 15 to 20 minutes.

salad.name: Cucumber and tomato salad
steps: Slice everything, add salt and lemon if you have it.

dahi.name: Yogurt (dahi)
steps: Eat plain, or with roti or rice.

milk.name: UHT milk
steps: Drink cold, or heat it if you have a kettle or microwave.

chai.name: Milk tea
steps: Boil water with tea leaves, add milk and sugar, simmer 2 minutes and strain.

banana.name: Banana
steps: Eat as it is.

apple.name: Apple
steps: Wash and eat.

guava.name: Guava
steps: Wash and eat.

dates.name: Dates
steps: Eat as they are.

chana_roast.name: Roasted chana
steps: Eat as it is.

peanuts.name: Peanuts
steps: Eat as they are.

peanut_butter.name: Peanut butter
steps: Spread on bread or eat from the spoon.

pasta_tomato.name: Tomato pasta
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water for 9 to 10 minutes and drain.
Fry onion in oil, add chopped tomato and spices and cook 10 minutes into a sauce.
Toss with the pasta and top with grated cheese.

pasta_chicken.name: Chicken pasta
pasta_chicken.serve: 1 plate (80 g dry pasta, 80 g chicken)
steps: Boil and drain the pasta.
Cook diced chicken in oil until done, add onion, capsicum and tomato and cook 8 minutes.
Mix in the pasta.

fried_rice.name: Egg fried rice
steps: Cook the rice and let it cool.
Scramble the egg in hot oil, add chopped vegetables and stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add rice and soy sauce and toss on high heat for 3 minutes.

chowmein.name: Chicken chow mein
steps: Boil the noodles, drain and rinse.
Stir-fry chicken strips, then the vegetables, on high heat.
Add noodles and soy sauce and toss for 2 minutes.

veg_stirfry.name: Vegetable stir-fry
steps: Slice the vegetables thinly.
Stir-fry in hot oil for 4 to 5 minutes and season with soy sauce.

chicken_stirfry.name: Chicken and vegetable stir-fry
steps: Slice chicken and vegetables thinly.
Stir-fry the chicken 5 minutes, add vegetables and soy sauce, cook 4 minutes.

chicken_wrap.name: Chicken wrap
steps: Cook spiced chicken pieces in a little oil.
Mix yogurt with salt for the sauce.
Fill the tortilla with chicken, sauce, tomato and cabbage and roll.

bean_burrito.name: Bean burrito
steps: Boil soaked lobia until soft and mash lightly with fried onion and spices.
Fill tortillas with beans, tomato and cheese, roll and warm in a pan.

cheese_toast.name: Cheese toast
steps: Top the bread with cheese.
Toast in a pan or oven until the cheese melts.

scrambled_eggs.name: Scrambled eggs
steps: Beat the eggs with salt and pepper.
Cook in a little oil on low heat, stirring, until just set.

pancakes.name: Pancakes
steps: Whisk flour, egg, milk and sugar into a smooth batter.
Cook small rounds on a lightly oiled pan until golden on both sides.

shakshuka.name: Shakshuka (eggs in tomato sauce)
steps: Cook onion and capsicum in oil, add chopped tomato and spices and simmer 12 minutes.
Make two wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 5 minutes.

lentil_soup.name: Lentil soup
steps: Fry onion and carrot in oil, add masoor, tomato, spices and 3 cups water.
Simmer 20 minutes and blend roughly.

chickpea_salad.name: Chickpea salad
steps: Boil soaked chana until soft (about 40 minutes) and cool.
Mix with chopped vegetables, oil and spices.

shawarma_plate.name: Chicken shawarma plate
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices, then pan-cook with oil.
Serve over rice with cucumber, tomato and yogurt sauce.

mashed_potato.name: Mashed potato
steps: Boil peeled potatoes until soft.
Mash with warm milk and oil.

tomato_soup.name: Tomato soup
steps: Cook onion in oil, add chopped tomato and 1 cup water.
Simmer 15 minutes, blend and season.
